“How can I—“ “You can go back go work. I can manage myself.” I said to him, more likely to myself while I was trying to stop myself from crying. I’ve finally felt that he left my table. I am packing my things maybe it’s better to go home than to embarrass myself more.

“I will loose my job. I am so terrible at my job. I was fired and I am just finishing mu transition but all I get are bad mouthing from my coworkers.” I started crying again. “My family disowned me because I was trying to follow my dreams. I’ve got no one.” I bit my lip.

I showed him the picture for him to see clearly. “Him?” I paused. “He was my first love and the only guy I ever loved and confessed to.” I mentally cursed myself remembering what I did because of what Choa said. “He dumped me.” I laughed bitterly. “He blocked me”

Did he left last night? I checked my night stand to see if he left his number. But there was none. I sighed. Kiss will be our only memory. I must be crazy last night. I might not see him ever again, anyway. I took a quick bath and went to the kitchen.

She took a deep breathe. “I saw your boyfriend with another girl.” She then looked down. I faked a laugh to hide the pain that I am feeling now. “So what? He has a lot of friends.” I told her. But what she told me next made my heart sank deeper.

“I saw Seongwoo with another girl, in a motel.” She took another deep breathe as if she was gathering all the strength that she has. “He didn’t saw me. I was walking around the area when I saw him. And Eunjung told me that she saw the same girl with Seongwoo at the cinema”

The truth is I never expected him to cheat. And no one ever saw it coming. Who would have thought that a guy like Seongwoo could do such a thing. I’ve noticed changes from his behavior the past 6 months. His text became shorter, he rarely calls. We rarely see each other.

As Seongwoo sat down, he asked if I wanted to watch or even stay the night. But I went straight to the point, I went here for a reason and I am here to know the answers. “Why did you cheat?” “Huh? What are you talking about? Chungah and I are just workmates and neighbors”

“I never said the name. I just asked why did you cheat” I slowly looked at him and the tears started to roll down my face. I felt the hotness of my own tears. It felt like burning like how my heart is burned into ashes. Seongwoo was taken aback witb my statement.

It has been 2months since the Seongwoo cheating incident. And ever since that incident Seongwoo had been the best boyfriend he could be. After my work he fetches me. I never asked him to do that but he does.

“It isn’t your fault. It was mine and mine alone. I’m sorry.” Seongwoo hugged me really tight like he doesn’t want to let go of me. “I won’t be seeing Chungah anymore. Let’s not break up.” With his words, as if I was captivated by a magic spell, I decided to stay with him.

“You should have told me that you are going to introduce your boyfriend. We should have made Seongwoo stay.” I told Eunjung. “He was your boyfriend? The guy who left a few minutes ago?” Jaehwan pointed at the door where Seongwoo went out. “Yes, why?” “Ahh” He scratched his head.

And I witnessed with my own two eyes his unfaithfulness. He was kissing Chungah in front of his apartment. Without any hesitation, I walked straight to them. “Can I borrow my boyfriend for a second?” They both stopped kissing and was startled by my presence.

“Ro—I can explain” I slapped him. And ended things with him once and for all. He did it once and he is doing it the second time or he never stop? I don’t want to fool myself anymore and told him my goodbye.
